description: This file defines the SimpleCommand class, a final immutable Java class that implements Jsonifiable, representing a simple command with a name, optional correlation ID, and optional payload. It includes methods to create instances from parameters or JSON, and to convert instances back into JSON. It also contains nested class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: SimpleCommand
classes.description: A final, immutable class representing a simple command with a command name, optional correlation ID, and optional payload, which can be serialized to and from JSON.

classes.name: SimpleCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested static class holding JSON field definitions for command properties: name, correlationId, and payload.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.of
methods.description: Creates a new SimpleCommand instance with specified commandName, correlationId, and payload.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SimpleCommand instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: SimpleCommand#getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name of the SimpleCommand.

methods.name: SimpleCommand#getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the correlation ID.

methods.name: SimpleCommand#getPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload JSON value.

methods.name: SimpleCommand#toJson
methods.description: Converts the SimpleCommand instance into a JSON object representation.
